sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Farooq Ayoob Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.108 of 2023, under Section 498A, 306 IPC,
P.S. Kothi, District Barabanki.
3.

In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the applicant, who is the son-in-law of the informant, was having illicit relations and used to beat the daughter of the informant because of which she committed suicide.
The cause of death, as per the postmortem report, is hanging.
There is no document on record to demonstrate abetment at the instance of the applicant as defined under Section 107 IPC.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Santosh Kumar vs State Of Thru. Prin. Secy.

5. Considering the law as explained in the case of Mariano Anto Bruno and Anr. v. Inspector of Police; 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1387, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Mariano Anto Bruno and Anr. v. Inspector of Police; 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1387
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view thereof,
the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Santosh Kumar be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
